stories.title: 'Connect us as humans': Springville art exhibit highlights research on isolation, social connection
stories.summary: The Springville Museum of Art connected with a BYU psychology professor to create an art exhibit focused on loneliness and the impact of social connection.

stories.title: BYU avoids scare, escapes Kansas with triple OT win on the road
stories.summary: BYU overcame offensive struggles and a missed potential game-winner to outlast Kansas 31-29 in triple overtime, keeping its postseason hopes alive with a dramatic victory.

stories.title: Speaker Johnson pleads with House Republicans to return to work after bruising midterm losses
stories.summary: House Speaker Mike Johnson, R-La., is pleading with Republicans to return to Capitol Hill after the Thanksgiving break, citing a slate of legislative priorities that must be addressed.

stories.title: Utah Shakespeare Festival among 3 honored with Governor's Mansion Artist Awards
stories.summary: The Utah Shakespeare Festival received the Governor's Mansion Artist Award during a Nov. 3 ceremony, recognized alongside painter Ron Richmond and late state Sen. Haven J. Barlow.

stories.title: 6 charged in alleged 'prostitution ring' that operated through Utah massage parlors
stories.summary: Six people are facing federal charges for allegedly operating a human trafficking and prostitution ring through massage parlors stretching from Orem to Ogden.

stories.title: How the Reids and a generous city made 'The Heart of America' the heart of the Giving Machines movement
stories.summary: Nearly a thousand miles away from Salt Lake City, where the charity vending machines first launched, Kansas City, Missouri, has rallied behind the Giving Machines.

stories.title: Route 66 barbershop builds community through license plate stories
stories.summary: A Route 66 barber has turned his shop into a community gathering place with a collection of about 400 license plates donated by customers and travelers from around the world.

stories.title: Person dies in crash on US 6 near Soldier Summit
stories.summary: A person died in a crash on U.S. Highway 6 near Soldier Summit on Friday night, according to the Utah Department of Public Safety. The crash shut down traffic for several hours, according to the Utah Highway Patrol.

stories.title: Resorts optimistic about ski season ahead of 2026 Thanksgiving weekend
stories.summary: At Alta Ski Area on Friday, spokesperson Lexi Dowdall said the resort already had a 60-inch base and was planning its Opening Day for Wednesday.

stories.title: (Not) up in the air: Travelers' trepidations spike as Thanksgiving nears and tech hiccups abound
stories.summary: Travelers are increasingly concerned about potential Thanksgiving flight disruptions following recent airline technology outages and rising holiday airfare costs, though demand for air travel remains strong.

stories.title: Utah lawmaker to seek program to help solve missing person, murder cases in Native community
stories.summary: Rep. Angela Romero is advocating for a training program for law enforcement on investigating missing person cases, particularly in the Indigenous community.

stories.title: Winter weather creates challenges for Utah drivers
stories.summary: Crashes and road closures are adding to travel concerns as winter weather settles into the state. On US-40, a crash involving an 18-wheeler forced the highway to close for a time on Friday.
